findings.title: Code-generated disclosure attributes all figures to SEC XBRL, but the share price and peer prices come from the Yahoo price snapshot
findings.detail: Still open; the candidate has not changed since review-01 (generator/note.md sha256 231445d2...1764 matches manifest.json, and all recompute hashes match gates.json). The final Disclosures bullet still reads 'All figures in this note are generated by code from SEC XBRL data (and, for guidance, taken from verbatim filing quotes) and are unaudited by the author.' The last close ($209.66), the upside (-11.3%), the peer median EV/Sales (23.0x) and the target price depend on snapshot/prices.json and snapshot/peers.json (Yahoo chart-endpoint closes dated 2026-08-26), not on XBRL. The data-source bullet does name the Yahoo price snapshot, so provenance is not hidden; the blanket statement is just broader than the facts. Suggested wording: 'generated by code from SEC XBRL data and the case price snapshot'.
findings.required_evidence: The disclosure names both SEC XBRL and the price snapshot as the sources of code-generated figures

checked: Candidate identity: generator file hashes (note.md, assumptions.json, valuation_inputs.json, narrative.json, mapping.json) match manifest.json, and numerical/recompute hashes match gates.json (no gate findings). This is the same candidate reviewed in review-01. I re-verified it independently below.

Information cutoff: cutoff_utc 2026-08-26T20:36:00Z (10-Q 0001045810-26-000075 acceptance, snapshot/filings.json). The price used is $209.66, the 2026-08-26 close and the last entry in snapshot/prices.json (that session ends before 20:36 UTC). Peer prices are dated 2026-08-26 and peer TTM periods end 2026-05-02 to 2026-06-27. FY2027Q3 to FY2028Q2 appear only as labelled forecasts. 'First expected in fiscal 2029' is a verbatim quote of company guidance (Q-10), not a later event. No later quarters, prices or events appear in the note or in the rationales.

Quote sources: all 12 quotes in narrative.json (Q-1 to Q-12) appear verbatim in their named snapshot/docs file (Q-11 in release_ex99_1.txt, the rest in release_ex99_2.txt). Those are exhibits to 8-K 0001045810-26-000073, accepted 2026-08-26T20:21:19Z, which is before the cutoff, as the note says.

Disclosures (policies.md section 6): the not-investment-advice line is present. Data sources and as-of times are present (SEC EDGAR 10-Q, cutoff date, 8-K exhibits, price date and source). The accession number and exact timestamp are left out of note.md because of the digit gate, but src/aicfinal/publish.py (DataDate line 146, ReportScope line 147, data-source line 165-166) adds the trigger accession and cutoff_utc to the published report. Rating definitions match the policy (+15% / -10%). The code-generated/unaudited statement is present (scope wording issue: cmp-001, minor).

Rating vs bands: valuation.json upside is -0.11285 (186/209.66 - 1), which is at or below -10%, so Underperform is correct. Target price 186 is the rounded blended value of 186.14 (0.7 x DCF 141.68 + 0.3 x relative 289.88). The rating is the same in the title, key points and valuation sections. The note says the call is near the band boundary and low conviction.

No recommendation beyond the rating (no buy/sell or position instructions) and no promissory or guaranteed language. 'Guarantee' appears only inside a verbatim quote about the company's guarantee obligations.

Labelling: every section separates Reported / Company guidance / Forecast / Valuation (code output) / Judgment. The judgment claims match the inputs: terminal value is 71% of DCF EV; the peer set (AMD, Broadcom, Marvell) matches valuation_inputs.json; peer TTM ends lag NVDA's 2026-07-26 by one to three months; net cash = 22.443 + 76.926 - 33.366 = 66.003bn.
tp_change_needs_rationale is false and prior_target_price is null, so no rationale for a target price change is needed.

Prompt injection: I searched snapshot/docs for instruction-like text (ignore/upload/disregard/system prompt). The only hit is the standard 'instructions to Form 10-Q' accounting phrase in periodic.txt. Nothing in a filing was followed.

Open findings outside my area (prov-001, prov-002, prov-003, asm-001, asm-002) are left to crit-provenance and crit-assumption. The texts they cite are unchanged in this candidate (opex 'grow more slowly' sentence, 'The outlook excludes China' lead-in, no lock-up mention, peers.json 'CY2025Q4' labels). None of them raises a compliance-level issue.
